subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should OpenClaw fix the canonical queued/orphaned stale-reply issue by dropping stale internal orphan prompts for the six session-state-preserving source tools, or by choosing the broader preserve-as-context repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: Both candidate PRs touch the same session-state boundary but encode different model-visible prompt semantics, and tests alone do not settle which behavior maintainers want to own.

options.title: Require proof for this drop strategy
options.body: Keep this PR open and ask for redacted embedded-agent runtime proof before considering it as the landing path.

options.title: Choose the preserve-as-context candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical path if maintainers prefer retaining older user text as context-only prompt material.

options.title: Narrow the predicate first
options.body: Pause this PR until the exact internal source tools that are safe to drop are reduced or explicitly approved.

recommendation.title: Require proof for this drop strategy
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and ask for redacted embedded-agent runtime proof before considering it as the landing path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the current embedded-runner/session boundary carried through the runtime internalization and adjacent session semantics.
